{{Quote|I sat down for a game of cards with a cheerful Lutrillian, the friendliest gambler in the place.|An entry of an artist's journal|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
'''Lutrillians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of [[humanoid]]s that were [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Lutrillia]]. They were distinguished by their broad faces, [[Hair|fuzzy]] jowls, and wide-set [[eye]]s. Lutrillians lived a nomadic lifestyle and traveled around their homeworld. They loved adventure and discovery, often going off-world to explore other cultures. They were considered, by other species, to be very agreeable, but had a small problem with greed.

At some point during the [[Clone Wars]], there were at least eight Lutrillian [[Prisoner|detainees]] in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on [[Coruscant]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], the Lutrillian [[Secon Daree]] was a [[Rebel pilot]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Ownellco]] and another Lutrillian visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina|the cantina]] of [[Mos Eisley]] the day [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] met [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]].

==Biology and appearance==
Lutrillians stood out for their broad faces with wide-set [[eye]]s. They had fuzzy jowls and long spiked [[ear]]s that pricked up. A Lutrillian's [[nose]] had a distinctive line that went vertically through the middle and through the upper lip. Their skin was usually [[Color|ruddy]],<ref name="Dec" /> it could also be white<ref name="Assassin" /> or brown.<ref name="Rebel Assault" /> Some Lutrillians had [[Hair|whiskers]] on their face.<ref name="SoE">''[[Servants of the Empire: The Secret Academy]]''</ref>

==Society and culture==
Lutrillians hailed from [[Lutrillia]],<ref name="Alien Archive" /> a planet<ref name="Traveler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> in the [[Yarith sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> The species tended to live a nomadic lifestyle on their homeworld avoiding subterranean predators.<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Lutrillians were fond of adventure and discovery and frequently traveled off-[[Planet|world]] to explore other cultures. They were considered very agreeable, but had a small problem with greed.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Lutrillians in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Kill him, Hardeen! Like the Jedi!|A Lutrillian, to Obi-Wan Kenobi (posing as Rako Hardeen)|<ref name="Dec" />}}
During [[382 BBY]],<ref name="PlanetXDate">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic: Quest for Planet X'' to [[382 BBY]].</ref> at [[Black Spire Outpost]], a Lutrillian, a human woman with brightly colored hair, and a human man were attempting to steal [[Sky Graf]]'s ship. Jedi Knight [[Rooper Nitani]] resolved the conflict before violence could break out.<ref name="PlanetX">[[The High Republic: Quest for Planet X]]</ref> In [[231 BBY]],<ref name="Trail of Shadows Date">The events of ''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 2 take place [[Standard week|weeks]] after the events of [[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 1|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 1]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[231 BBY]].</ref> one Lutrillian was present talking with a [[Koorivar]] in the streets of [[Efavan]], a city on the world of [[Vorzyd V]].<ref name="Trail of Shadows">[[The High Republic: Trail of Shadows 1|''The High Republic: Trail of Shadows'' 1]]</ref> Sometime before 48 BBY,<ref name="48BBYDate">''Mace Windu'' 1 establishes its events take place prior to [[Mace Windu]]'s entry into the [[Jedi High Council]]. ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' establishes that Windu is part of the Jedi Council at the [[time]] of [[Nim Pianna]]'s [[Mutiny on the Advent|death]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[48 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Mace Windu'' 1 must take place by that [[Standard year|year]].</ref> a Lutrillian, Regump, ran tugboat docking remotes the ocean moon of [[Devshi]]. Regump was mind-tricked by a young [[Mace Windu]] into becoming a Skiff Captain during Windu's [[Mission to Devshi]]<ref name="Mace Windu 1">[[Mace Windu 1|''Mace Windu'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:LutrillianPrisonerBlasterRifle-Deception.png|thumb|left|200px|A Lutrillian prisoner]]
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="JuggernautDate">{{TBBDate|312}}</ref> a Lutrillian was prisoner on the planet [[Erebus]]. The prisoner was loaded onto a [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]] but was later set free by [[Clone Force 99]] during the [[Rescue of Edmon Rampart]].<ref name="Juggernaut">{{TBB|Juggernaut (episode)}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars]], the Lutrillian [[Maysano]] was a criminal wanted for [[Death|murder]].<ref name="Assassin" /> The Lutrillians mugshot was seen by [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Tera Sinube]] on a computer at the [[Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> At least eight Lutrillians were in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]], and many became involved in a [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center|riot]] that saw the escape of [[Moralo Eval]], [[Cad Bane]], and a disguised [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Dec" />

During the [[Imperial Era]], [[Pomi Harchmak]], a Lutrillian who worked for [[Pryce Mining]], a [[mining]] company on [[Lothal]], she managed heavy-equipment inventory operations. She was accused by [[Arihnda Pryce]] of embezzling funds to clear the guilt from Pryce's Mother.<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> A set of two sad looking Lutrillians blocked automated load lifters in [[Lothal]]'s Old City<ref name="RebelRanks">[[Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks]]</ref> in 5 ABY.<ref name="RebelRanksDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Servants of the Empire: Rebel in the Ranks'' to [[5 BBY]].</ref> On Lothal in 4 BBY,<ref name="SecretAcademyDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Servants of the Empire: The Secret Academy'' to [[4 BBY]].</ref> an [[Unidentified Lutrillian warehouse manager|Lutrillian]] foreman provided shelter to criminals from the [[Gray Syndicate]] in his warehouse. One such criminal was artist and poet [[Holshef]] who he hid in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. Holshef had been late with payment so [[Merei Spanjaf]] payed his debt for the week in his stead. the next week the Lutrillian became agitated with the empire's efforts to crackdown on dissidents so Spanjaf paid him double his due.<ref name="Secret Academy">''[[Servants of the Empire: The Secret Academy]]''</ref> 

[[File:Secon Daree RA.png|thumb|right|200px|Secon Daree flew with the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] during the attack on Lothal]]
A Lutrillian named [[Secon Daree]]<ref name="Rebel Assault Trivia">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/rebel-assault-trivia-gallery|text="Rebel Assault" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> was a part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] by [[1 BBY]] and fought in the [[attack on Lothal]].<ref name="Rebel Assault" /> In 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="IV Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> two Lutrillians,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> one of whom was named [[Ownellco]],<ref name="Mythe">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref> were at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] met [[Han Solo]].<ref name="ANH" /> In 0 ABY,<ref name="DateSW2015-8">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'' (2015) 8 to [[0 ABY]].</ref>, a Lutrillian was present in a [[Unidentified bar (Nar Shaddaa)|bar]] on [[Nar Shaddaa]] and was shocked when the Jedi Knight [[Luke Skywalker]] drew his Lightsaber.<ref name="SW2015-8">[[Star Wars (2015) 8|''Star Wars'' (2015) 8]]</ref> 

Another Lutrillian was present in a [[Unidentified casino (Han Solo)|Casino]] shortly after the Battle of Yavin sitting at a [[gambling]] table when Skywalker and Solo bet and lost the [[Currency|money]] they were meant to buy supplies with.<ref name="Star Wars 16">[[Star Wars (2015) 16|''Star Wars'' (2015) 16]]</ref> During the [[Escape from Cloud City|escape]] from [[Cloud City]], a Lutrillian was observed running down a hallway as [[Baron Administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] instructed citizens to evacuate before the [[Galactic Empire]] fully occupied the facility. The Lutrillian ran alongside several other citizens past Calrissian, while [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] ran in the opposite direction.<ref name="ESB" />

Within [[Akiva]]'s capital city of [[Myrra]]<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)]]</ref> in [[4 ABY]],<ref name="AftermathDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Aftermath'' to [[4 ABY]].</ref> a Lutrillian was present sleeping with a half eaten [[amphibian]] in his hand. He was just barely startled when [[Norra Wexley]] rode past in a speeder.<ref name="Aftermath" /> Sometime after [[34 ABY]],<ref name="AlienArchiveJournalDate">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref> a journal containing an illustration of a Lutrillian was displayed at the [[Graf Archive]] on [[Orchis 2]].<ref name="Alien Archive" /> The illustration was created by an [[Unidentified artist|unknown artist]] and was later restored and expanded during the [[Graf Archive restoration effort]] under [[Deputy Director]] of the archive [[Xoddam Lothipp]].<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CantinaCostumesPanel.png|thumb|left|300px|Two Lutrillian costumes were produced for ''A New Hope'']]
Lutrillians first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], directed by [[George Lucas]]<ref name="ANH" /> and released in [[1977]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> While the species were not named on screen in the film, they were identified first within the [[Star Wars Legends]] continity in the second edition of the book [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']] released in [[1996]] and written by [[Michael Stern]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref> In the rebooted [[Canon]] continuity, the Lutrillians were first identified in episode guide for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode [[Deception]].<ref name="Dec" />

The Lutrillians first appeared in the background of the cantina scene of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], released in [[1977]]. [[Stuart Freeborn]] designed the characters from costume sketches by [[John Mollo]].<ref name="Star Wars Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The species were originally called Hair Mouse during production.<ref name="Archeology2025" /> 

The eyes of the mask were made of thermoformed plastic.<ref name="Objets">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref> There were two Lutrillian mask made for ''A New Hope'', One with flocked hair and one without, and also sported subtle changes to the eyes and wrinkles.<ref name="Archeology2025">{{YouTube|video=IVmT3cWZkvE|text=Who lurks in the shadows of the Star Wars Cantina PT. 1 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions}}</ref> The Lutrillian identified as [[Atheloe]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends continuity]]<ref name="RG">{{InsiderCite|130|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley}}</ref> featured more in the "Lost Cut" of the film, where one of them spoke to an [[Unidentified bug-faced species]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>
